result.summary: Found 1 issue: a raw localization key is displayed as a section title instead of translated content.

issues.description: Section header below 'Fastest near you' displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper localized string (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add fallback handling for missing translations.
